notes.title: Handlebar in VR mode!
notes.content:
Hello!

Many of you guys asked us to add ability to control the bike via motion controllers in VR (by using bike's handlebar). You can try it out right now!

- Added function to control the bike by handlebar in VR mode.
- The road ramp in Escape game mode automatically adjusts to your road section.
- Tiny fixes in English and Spanish localizations.

* Note that the config directory was renamed from "Game" to "BikeRush" so if you want to keep old settings, you can move your settings to the new version from path C:\Users\<UserName>\AppData\Local\Game to C:\Users\<UserName>\AppData\Local\BikeRush

tags.feature: - Added function to control the bike by handlebar in VR mode.
- The road ramp in Escape game mode automatically adjusts to your road section.

tags.bug: - Tiny fixes in English and Spanish localizations.

notes.title: Release coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello!

We're planning to leave Early Access soon with an update which will include 2 new maps and updated user interface. 

At now you can try the new patch:
- New animations on final scoreboard.
- Added your's syndicate cars at the finish waiting for you.
- Added screen notification when you can fully control the bike (when leaving the trailer).
- Removed blocking police cars in Escape game mode (when leaving the trailer).
- In auto steer game modes (1st and 3rd), when you get onto the opposite site of the road you will be teleported on your side of the road.

notes.title: The first patch!

tags.feature: - The "Live" bonus is added to the Escape game mode;
- The trains now is moving randomly;
- To open second map you need only 6 level;

tags.balance_change: - You get more XP at the end of the race;
- Reload speed of the pistol is now 1.4s (instead of 2.1)
- Reload speed of the grenade is now 2.0s (instead if 3.0)
- The bike is now more stable when using nitro;

tags.bug: - Fixed black screen bug in VR;
- Fixed game result panel rotation bug in VR;
- Fixed bug when you could take damage when not started the race.
